title: Runtime config: add profile_version pin + customer override guardrails (audit hook)
author: Ethan Park
description:
Motivation: As we roll out the versioned hardware tuning profile pack, Dedicated/Private customers (and on-call) need a safe way to pin a known-good profile pack version during incidents/POCs and to keep upgrades deterministic. This PR adds a new runtime config field `profile_version` that pins the profile pack artifact version used for selection. It also adds customer override support with guardrails and an audit-log hook so changes are attributable and reversible.

What’s in this PR: (1) Config schema: Introduce `runtime.profiles.profile_version` (string). When set, the runtime resolves profiles only from that pack version and logs the effective version at startup + on model load. (2) Precedence: `profile_version` pin applies after fleet defaults but before per-profile knob overrides. Order: hard runtime minimums/safety constraints -> env/flags for internal testing -> control-plane (Hosted) / customer config (Dedicated/Private) pin -> fleet default pack version. (3) Guardrails: Validate requested `profile_version` against (a) known installed pack versions, (b) compatibility matrix (GPU SKU + driver/CUDA baseline), and (c) safety constraints (e.g., refuse versions marked `blocked=true`, refuse versions requiring features not present in the current runtime build). On failure, runtime falls back to fleet default and emits a structured warning + audit event. (4) Audit log hook: On config load, emit `runtime.profile_version.pin_applied` with {org_id, customer_id, actor, requested_version, effective_version, source, outcome, reason}. For Private installs where audit sink may be disabled, we still write a local structured log event with the same fields. (5) Operator UX: `/health` and debug bundle now include `profile_pack_version_effective` and `profile_pack_version_requested`.

Notes / non-goals: This does not change default profile selection logic beyond using the pinned pack version if present. It also does not add any new profiles; it’s purely version pinning + safety/audit plumbing.

Rollout: Hosted will continue to use fleet defaults only (no customer pin). Dedicated/Private can set `runtime.profiles.profile_version` via their config (and via helm values for Private in a follow-up chart PR). SRE runbook will reference this knob for mitigation (pin/rollback).
commits: runtime/config: add profile_version to config schema and docs
runtime/profiles: implement pack-version resolution + fallback behavior
audit: emit profile_version pin events (success/failure) with reason codes
tests: schema validation + audit event golden snapshots
ops: add effective/requested profile pack version to /health + debug bundle
conversation:
Noah Patel (review): Can we be explicit about precedence? I’m worried we’ll end up with “pin” being overridden by env flags in prod. Also: what’s the behavior when the requested pack version isn’t present on disk? Ethan Park (author): Added an explicit precedence table in code comments + docs; internal env flag remains behind `RUNTIME_ALLOW_UNSAFE_PROFILE_TEST_FLAGS` and is ignored unless `build_tag=dev`. For missing pack versions: we now hard-fail validation with reason code `PACK_NOT_INSTALLED`, fall back to fleet default, and emit audit + warning.

Sean Gallagher (review): Guardrails look good, but we need to ensure we page/ticket on repeated failures to honor a requested pin (otherwise Dedicated customers think they’re pinned when they’re not). Can we add a metric? Ethan Park (author): Added counter `runtime_profile_version_pin_failures_total{reason}` and included it in the audit event; alerting will be handled in the observability-pack PR, but the signal is here.

Benji Okafor (review): For audit fields, please avoid including raw config blobs; only include requested/effective versions and a compact reason. Also, ensure “actor” is set to `system` when coming from file/helm. Ethan Park (author): Done. Actor is now derived from source: `control_plane`, `customer_config`, `env`, `system_default`. For file-based config it’s `customer_config` with actor `system` unless a control-plane identity header is present.

Rafael Mendes (review): What’s the rollback story? If we pin a bad version, do we get stuck? Ethan Park (author): Rollback is just removing/changing the pin. Additionally, if the pinned version is marked blocked (via registry metadata) we refuse to apply it and automatically fall back, with audit reason `BLOCKED_VERSION`.

Connor O'Brien (release): Please add a short release note blurb for 1.22 and confirm backport policy if we need to hotfix guardrails. Ethan Park (author): Added release note snippet to the PR description and flagged as safe-to-backport; no API surface change outside config field.

Final approvals: Noah Patel approved. Sean Gallagher approved. Benji Okafor approved. Connor O’Brien approved.
release_notes: Runtime 1.22: Adds `runtime.profiles.profile_version` to pin the hardware tuning profile pack version (Dedicated/Private). Includes guardrails and audit logging for applied/failed pins; exposes requested/effective pack version in health/debug endpoints.
merge_outcome: Merged (squash) into main; will ship with runtime-1.22 release train.
